note: Bodley Ave. (edges y 2027-2096, centre y ~2062) runs east only to Summit Avenue and ends there (T at about x 3088, y 2062). East of Summit, lot 59 runs unbroken south to the City of Cincinnati Subdiv'n line at y ~2094 (dimensions 225.58' / S.205.50'), so Bodley does not reach Mt. Hope in 1922. Its prolongation would meet the Mt. Hope centreline (edges x 3500-3590) at about x 3545, y 2062; only a dashed 54-inch sewer crosses lot 59 to Mt. Hope there.

Hatmaker St. is printed (edges y ~650-735, centre y ~692). There is no lane at x ~6086: the block between Hatmaker and Staebler is solid lots (161-179 and 1-25 / 180-202, Harrison Playground). The only lane off the south side of Hatmaker is the narrow 'Oswaldt' alley at x ~5733, about 350 px west. It dead-ends at y ~880 and does not reach Staebler.

Staebler St. is printed (edges y ~990-1032). There is no lane meeting it from the north at x ~6093: the block between Hatmaker and Staebler is solid lots (13-16 and 192-189 at that x). The narrow 'Oswaldt' alley at x ~5733 off Hatmaker dead-ends at y ~880 and does not reach Staebler.

N. Chateau Ave. (60 ft, edges x 2593-2685) runs south from Bodley Ave. (edges y 2027-2096) to Nonaly Ave. No street named Wilsonia appears; Chateau is the only street meeting Bodley at the expected point, so it is taken as the older name for Wilsonia Drive.

River Road is printed 'W. Sixth' here (label around x 3530, y 6050). Near x 3561, y 5825, no street meets it: lot 22 and the lots to its north (43/58) front directly on W. Sixth, with only lot lines (D.300') between them. 'GALVIN SUBDIV'N.' is subdivision lettering at about x 3650-3720, y 4700-4870. An unnamed narrow lane inside it (addresses 2500/2501, around x 3700-3770, y 4460-4800) runs off Mt. Hope Rd., not to W. Sixth.

Prospect Pl. (edges y ~2213-2257) meets the east side of Mt. Hope (edges x 3500-3590; the lines at x ~3527 and ~3555 are a pipe and a sewer). Nothing continues west of Mt. Hope. Prospect Place is taken as today's Zech Street. The circle at x ~3520, y ~2240 is a map symbol.
